title: Insolvency Watch: major listed Indian companies under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code
method: Hand-curated from tribunal records, IBBI filings, company exchange filings and financial press. Every case cites at least one source. Where sources disagree, the note says so and the more official source (NCLT/IBBI order or exchange filing) is used. A field that could not be verified is null rather than estimated. “RBI's first 12” are the accounts the RBI sent for insolvency in June 2017; the RBI did not publish the names, so membership is as reported by the press. Eleven appear here; the twelfth, Era Infra Engineering, is left out because its outcome could not be verified. Recovery is the share of financial creditors' admitted claims recovered, as reported; reports differ on the base, so treat it as approximate.
training_data_note: Companies marked in_training_labels also appear in data/sources/india_distress_labels.csv, which the model trains on. This page shows facts only, never a model score for them: a score for a company the model learned from is not a prediction.
